title: Binomial coefficients are symmetric
statement: For all natural numbers n and k with k ≤ n, C(n, k) = C(n, n - k).

formal.statement: theorem Nat.choose_symm : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat.le x1 x0) -> Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.choose x0 x1) (AxNat.choose x0 (AxNat.sub x0 x1)))))
